cappuccino.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: square item illustration for a cozy tavern equipment menu
Primary request: a single cappuccino served in a white ceramic cup and saucer, with thick velvety milk foam and a soft pale milk-colored ring visible in the coffee center; appetizing and clearly recognizable as cappuccino.
Scene/backdrop: warm wooden tavern tabletop, softly suggested and uncluttered.
Style/medium: warm watercolor storybook product illustration matching the project's existing Americano and butter croissant menu art; hand-painted paper texture, gentle outlines, warm natural colors.
Composition/framing: centered close product view, cup and saucer fully visible, generous clean margins, square image.
Lighting/mood: soft warm indoor light, calm welcoming café mood.
Constraints: one cup only, clean focal subject, no people, no lettering, no logo, no watermark.
